A 14-row threshold table at 0x08025da4 (loop count fixed by cmp r5,#0xe), 14 version strings at 0x08024234 and version setters bind six init functions to clock entries 080108ac (16/32 MHz) and 08010960 (8 MHz). The running clock is NOT a hardcoded 64 MHz; the USB 64 MHz result is used only to check the LOAD arithmetic.
